title: exactly the limit does not breach
why: P1 from Mon 09:00 (540) to 13:00 (780) = 240 business minutes; breach needs used > 240, i.e. t = 781 > now.

title: breach one minute past the limit, still running at now
why: A: used(781) = 241 > 240 so breached_at = 781 = now. B only moves now to 781.

title: priority raise at the breach minute prevents the breach
why: At 781 events apply first: limit becomes 480, used 241 <= 480. Closed at 800 with 260.

title: priority raise one minute late does not undo a breach
why: Breach at 781 under P1 is sticky; the P2 raise at 782 does not clear it.

title: priority lowered while paused breaches immediately
why: 300 used by the pause at 840 (P2, fine). At 2000 PRIORITY P1: 300 > 240, breach at 2000 = now, still paused.

title: nights and weekends do not count
holiday declared after now still applies; duplicate and weekend holidays
why: Mon-Wed 09:00-17:00 = 1440 minus Tuesday (holiday, declared twice) = 960. Saturday holiday changes nothing. Holidays at 2000/7300 do not move now (3900).

title: holiday lines never move now
why: now = 600, not 9000. A has 60 minutes; if the holiday moved now, A would run to Monday 17:00 and breach.

title: out-of-order arrival, stable order for equal minutes
why: Sorted: 540 OPEN; 600 CLOSE then REOPEN (stream order); 660 PAUSE. Used 60 + 60 = 120, paused.

title: OPEN after CLOSE resets and clears; REOPEN continues and keeps
why: Both run 540-900 at P1 (360, breach 781). A: OPEN P3 Tue 09:00 resets, closed after 60. B: REOPEN continues to 420, breach kept.

title: ignored transitions and malformed lines
why: A: 540-600 = 60, PRIORITY on CLOSED ignored, trimmed REOPEN at 720, close at 800: +80 = 140. Z never opened: omitted. Every other odd line is malformed; R runs 540-800 = 260 (malformed 5000 does not move now).

title: case-sensitive ticket IDs in code-point order
why: Order T1, T10, T2, t1. Each ran 540-600.

title: empty stream
why: No events.

title: only holidays and garbage
why: No well-formed ticket events: [].

title: breach across a weekend and a Monday holiday
why: Open Fri 15:00 (6660): 120. Mon of week 1 is a holiday. Tue 09:00 (12060) is minute #121; #241 is 12180, so breached_at 12181. Closed Tue 12:00 (12240): 300.

title: paused stops the clock; close after pause adds nothing
why: A: 540-600 = 60, paused, closed. B moves now to 1000 and has 0.

title: pausing at the breach minute still breaches
why: used(781) counts minutes before 781 = 241 > 240; the PAUSE at 781 does not change that.

title: leading zeros and whitespace
why: Fields are trimmed; 0540 is 540.

title: 17:00 is not a business minute, 09:00 is
why: Open Mon 16:59 (1019): 1 minute. Close Tue 09:00 (1980): Tue 09:00 itself is not before 1980. Used 1.

title: breach while the clock is stopped overnight is dated at the next minute after the 241st
why: Open Mon 13:00 (780): 240 minutes by 17:00 (1020). The 241st is Tue 09:00 (1980), so breached_at 1981, not 1021.
